checks.name: the translation TLC read defines Terminating and puts it in Next

notes: The PlusCal source is the W0-S04 spike module that RUN-spectacle-s5s8 also translated; no lesson cell holds the PlusCal text (S5.L2 and D-09 describe it). The translated module TLC read is saved as an output of the default configuration.

Each configuration runs two commands in one work dir: pcal.trans -nocfg, then TLC. A configuration's argv is the TLC command and argv_before the translation; the top-level argv lists both, in order, for the primary configuration. The exit code is TLC's.

<sandbox>/work in argv stands for a fresh scratch copy of the configuration's inputs, mounted read-write at /w because TLC writes its *_TTrace_* files beside the spec; its state queue goes under -metadir /tmp/tlc-states inside the container.
The bench image runs as uid 1000; the jar it holds has the pinned SHA-256 above, and its version line is the 1.8.0 pre-release banner, copied as printed.

Recorded for W1 follow-up 1 (docs/waves/W1-report.md, "Record the runs"). The run@1 task field only accepts a task id of the form W<n>-T<nn> or W<n>-S<nn>, so the follow-up is named in task_label instead.
